item.title: Director Liability for Insolvent Trading When Closing Solar Co
item.description: Most of what is written about insolvent trading is written for lawyers, by lawyers. You search for what happens to a director when the business goes under and you get a wall of section numbers, cash flow tests and safe harbour clauses explained in the abstract. None of it tells you what any of it means when the specific decision in front of you is whether to take a five thousand dollar deposit on Monday for a system you are not sure you can install.
